items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Willard Alexander calls me every once in a while

ctx.x: Oh, beautiful publicity. But it was -- so many outrageous things happened, I mean that it's really more a life story, than shall we say that has to do with the music world, although it did happen on account of the music world. But I want to get back to one thing, and that was that I said that '73, that appearance up in Canada was the last thing I've done, and probably will be the last thing I've done

musically, because I've turned down, oh, feelers from -- Willard Alexander calls me every once in a while and says, "Hey, what about --," I know exactly what happened, he found one big money date and he wants to hinge a whole tour on one date, and then you've got to go through all that, the arrangements I have are getting old. I would have to get some new things, and I would have to buy a wardrobe. My whole lifestyle has changed, and I'm very happy with it. I'm into a different thing, fortunately, because I was…
You spend, you said, seven months of the year, is that right, in Palm Springs, in the desert --
